restrictions: Exactly 33-byte messages: 32 bytes from a fresh uniform 256-bit word and one masked byte of a second independent fresh word; both complete random draws charged.
One batch of 2^128 samples; all repeats and failures charged; no restart.
Unkeyed BLAKE3-256, two prefix rounds, fixed IV, one length33 counter0 root compression with flags11; standard zero fill for word loading.

Classical 256-bit word RAM; generation inserts four-word records into low-digit linked buckets, ordered bucket traversal compares per-high-digit predecessors; one record array and two 2^128-word pointer tables; complete final verification.
Analytical distribution-free birthday construction with no heuristic, precomputed collision or full-scale execution claim.
Record storage is initialized by charged complete first writes; both pointer tables are explicitly zeroed, with all construction, links, traversal, predecessor accesses and failures charged.
Halt traversal at first full-digest match; repeated input then causes failure. Message fields are checked only in this one terminal phase; probability proof subtracts every repeated-input outcome.
A read-only bank of public IV, masks, zero, length, flags and fixed addresses is initialized once and preserved; every per-sample state/input store is still charged.
